title: Tunisian Cheesy Tagine
description: A traditional North African dish, the Tagine is a flavorful stew made with rich ingredients.

ingredients.name: Tagine spice mix
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern or North African markets

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in the Tagine spice mix and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cheesy sauce and stir to combine. Bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let cook for 5-7 minutes or until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Stir in the grated cheese until melted and smooth.
Transfer the sauce to a baking dish or individual ramekins.
Top with additional grated cheese and a sprinkle of parsley.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until the cheese is golden brown and bubbly.
Serve hot with pita bread on the side.
